title: Run Snowball Run
seo_title: Run Snowball Run — Play Free Snowball Runner Game Online
meta_desc: Play Run Snowball Run free online. Jump and slide a rolling snowball through pixel worlds, dodge obstacles and flying enemies in an endless runner.
desc: Run Snowball Run sends a rolling snowball through endless pixel landscapes. Time your jumps, slide under low blocks, and watch the sky for flying enemies as the levels never stop coming.
howto: Press X to jump over obstacles.
Press Z to slide under barriers.
Avoid ground traps and flying enemies.
Collect pickups to build your score.
Survive as the procedural levels speed up.
tips: Slide only when a barrier is genuinely low — jumping is usually safer.
Listen for the flying-enemy cue before committing to a jump.
Stay mid-screen to keep both escape routes open.
